name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
ministry_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
education_level: Regular undergraduate, postgraduate, and eligible professional degree courses
family_income_ceiling: Gross parental/family income not exceeding ₹4,50,000 per annum
eligibility_official: Fresh applicants must be in the relevant top-percentile list after Class XII, pursue a regular course rather than correspondence or distance study, meet the family-income ceiling, and not receive another scholarship or fee reimbursement. Renewal requires promotion, at least 50% marks, and 75% attendance.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are in the relevant Class XII top-percentile list, are studying a regular recognized course, meet the income limit, and do not receive another scholarship.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three undergraduate years; ₹20,000 per annum at postgraduate level and eligible fourth/fifth professional-course years; paid through Aadhaar-seeded bank-account DBT.
application_mode: Online through the National Scholarship Portal
application_window: The active NSP cycle and cut-off dates must be checked before applying.
notes_flags: The official 2025-26 FAQ states top-percentile, ₹4.5 lakh income, regular-course, 50% marks, and 75% attendance conditions; display the live NSP dates.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
ministry_department: Ministry of Rural Development
eligibility_official: Adult members of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work may demand employment under the Act through the local Gram Panchayat.
eligibility_plain: If you are an adult living in a rural household and want permitted manual work, your household can request employment through the local Panchayat.
benefits: Employment is to be provided within the statutory framework, with up to 100 days of work per rural household per financial year subject to applicable rules and demand.
documents_required: Identity and residence proof as required by the local authority
Bank or postal account details for payment
application_mode: Offline through Gram Panchayat and official MGNREGA channels
application_window: Demand-driven; local implementation applies.
notes_flags: Wage rates vary by notified area and year; do not hard-code a single national wage rate.

name: Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry_department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
eligibility_official: Street vendors holding a Certificate of Vending or identity card issued by an Urban Local Body, including eligible surveyed vendors awaiting documentation under applicable rules.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an eligible urban street vendor recognized by the local authority.
benefits: Working-capital support, incentives for regular repayment, and incentives for digital transactions under the current scheme terms.
documents_required: Certificate of Vending or vendor identity card
Local-body or survey record where applicable
application_mode: Online through the official PM SVANidhi portal or assisted local-body channel
application_window: Subject to current programme terms and lending windows.
notes_flags: Verify current tranche amounts before publication; the e-Shram page confirms purpose but not all current loan terms.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
ministry_department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
education_level: Eligible school-leaver and youth training pathways
eligibility_official: Indian nationals meeting the current programme and course requirements; the official e-Shram listing describes eligibility examples including 10th-pass or 12th-dropout candidates and an 18–45 age range.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an Indian youth who meets the current course, age, and training-centre requirements.
benefits: Skill training, assessment, certification, and support through approved training centres under the current programme version.
documents_required: Bank details where the selected programme provides a financial benefit
application_mode: Online or through an approved training centre
application_window: Course and centre availability varies.
notes_flags: Verify active programme version, course list, and current age rules before publication.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
ministry_department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; KVIC implementation
education_level: At least Class VIII for larger projects under the cited eligibility rule
eligibility_official: Indian individuals aged above 18 may apply for eligible new enterprise projects; at least Class VIII qualification is required for projects above the stated manufacturing or service cost thresholds.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an adult planning an eligible new micro-enterprise and meet the education requirement for a larger project.
benefits: Financial assistance through a credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new enterprises.
application_mode: Online through the official KVIC PMEGP portal
application_window: Subject to current KVIC and lending-channel availability.
notes_flags: Verify current subsidy percentages, project ceilings, and applicant contribution before publication.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
ministry_department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
eligibility_official: A person who does not have another bank account may open a basic savings bank deposit account through a bank branch or Business Correspondent outlet.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an unbanked person seeking a basic bank account.
benefits: No minimum-balance requirement, interest on deposits, RuPay debit card, eligible accidental-insurance cover, overdraft facility for eligible account holders, and access to DBT-linked schemes.
documents_required: Identity and address proof accepted by the bank
application_mode: Offline through a bank branch or Business Correspondent outlet
application_window: Open subject to bank and KYC processes.
notes_flags: Verify current overdraft and insurance terms at the participating bank before application.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
ministry_department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
family_income_ceiling: Poor household based on prescribed deprivation declaration
eligibility_official: A woman aged 18 or above from an eligible poor household, with no other LPG connection from an Oil Marketing Company in the same household.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an adult woman in an eligible poor household that does not already have an LPG connection.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection assistance, with current connection assistance terms including cylinder, regulator, hose, consumer card, inspection/installation charges, and a first refill and stove under the current PMUY terms.
documents_required: Address proof where Aadhaar address differs
application_mode: Online through an official Oil Marketing Company portal or offline through the nearest LPG distributor
application_window: Subject to current PMUY availability and distributor process.
notes_flags: Connection assistance and refill terms can change; show the live PMUY page before application.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
ministry_department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
family_income_ceiling: Eligibility includes disadvantaged categories and current PMMVY criteria
eligibility_official: Eligible pregnant and lactating mothers under current PMMVY rules, implemented as a Centrally Sponsored Maternity Benefits Scheme; category and documentation conditions apply.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are a pregnant or lactating mother who meets the current PMMVY category and documentation rules.
benefits: ₹5,000 through DBT for the first child and ₹6,000 for an eligible second child when the second child is a girl, subject to current scheme conditions.
documents_required: Category or vulnerability proof where applicable
Child and mother records required by the implementing authority
application_mode: Through the prescribed Anganwadi, health-facility, or official PMMVY channel
application_window: Apply within the current PMMVY time limits communicated by the implementing channel.
notes_flags: The official page states Odisha and Telangana are not implementing PMMVY; surface this jurisdiction exception.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
ministry_department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
eligibility_official: Savings bank account holders aged 18–50 in participating banks may join; a person with multiple accounts may join through only one account, and Aadhaar is the primary KYC for the bank account.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are 18–50 and hold an eligible savings account with a participating bank.
benefits: One-year renewable life insurance cover for death due to any reason, subject to the scheme rules and insurer terms.
documents_required: Claim form for beneficiaries where applicable
application_mode: Through a participating bank or approved channel
application_window: Annual enrollment/renewal cycle as communicated by the participating bank.
notes_flags: Confirm current premium and cover amount from the latest official rules/FAQ before publication.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
ministry_department: Ministry of Rural Development
eligibility_official: Rural houseless households and households living in eligible kutcha or dilapidated houses, identified through housing-deprivation parameters and verified through the prescribed Gram Sabha and programme process.
eligibility_plain: You may be considered if your rural household is houseless or lives in an eligible kutcha or dilapidated house and passes the official deprivation and verification process.
benefits: Financial assistance for a pucca house, with different assistance levels for plain and difficult areas, plus convergence support for sanitation, wage labour, LPG, water, and electricity under applicable programme rules.
documents_required: Documents requested by the Gram Panchayat or programme authority
application_mode: Through the official PMAY-G/Gram Panchayat beneficiary-registration process
application_window: Beneficiary identification and registration follow programme and State/UT implementation cycles.
notes_flags: The captured myScheme page includes historical extension dates; recheck the current PMAY-G phase and assistance rates before publication.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
ministry_department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
family_income_ceiling: Income band depends on the active PMAY-U 2.0 vertical and current guidelines
eligibility_official: Beneficiary families in eligible urban areas that do not own a pucca house in the name of the household or its members, subject to the active PMAY-U vertical, income category, and State/UT process.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if your eligible urban household does not own a pucca house and meets the current income and vertical-specific rules.
benefits: Housing assistance under the active PMAY-U vertical, with the amount and form of support determined by the current operational guidelines and beneficiary category.
documents_required: Documents requested by the ULB or implementing agency
application_mode: Through the official PMAY-U/ULB application or demand-survey process
application_window: Subject to the active PMAY-U 2.0 guidelines and local-body process.
notes_flags: The official page contains legacy PMAY-U vertical information; publish only after reconciling it with current PMAY-U 2.0 guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry_department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility_official: Eligible landholding farmer families as defined under the PM-KISAN guidelines, subject to State/UT identification and exclusion categories covering institutional landholders, certain public-office holders, specified government employees or pensioners, income-tax payers, and practicing professionals.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if your family holds eligible agricultural land and does not fall within the official exclusion categories.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments through direct bank transfer.
application_mode: Online through the official PM-KISAN portal, mobile app, or prescribed assisted/state channel
application_window: Registration and status services remain subject to portal and State/UT processes.
notes_flags: Portal currently states eKYC is mandatory and displays current installment information; always check Know Your Status and latest exclusions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
ministry_department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility_official: Farmers in notified areas and crops may enroll under the applicable PMFBY operational guidelines and State/season notification.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you grow a notified crop in a notified area during the applicable season and meet the current enrollment rules.
benefits: Crop-insurance protection under the applicable season, crop, State, premium, and loss-assessment rules, with policy status and grievance/crop-loss reporting services.
documents_required: Lease or cultivation proof where applicable
application_mode: Online through the official PMFBY portal or authorized bank/insurance/CSC channel
application_window: State- and season-specific enrollment deadlines apply.
notes_flags: Premium, crop, area, cutoff, and loss-reporting rules must be read from the current operational guideline and State notification.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry_department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
family_income_ceiling: Eligibility is determined through the applicable beneficiary database and current PM-JAY rules; do not infer it from income alone.
eligibility_official: Beneficiary eligibility follows the current National Health Authority and State/UT implementation rules and beneficiary identification process.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are included in the applicable PM-JAY beneficiary database or current expansion category and can complete the official verification process.
benefits: Cashless health-service access at empanelled facilities under the current PM-JAY package and beneficiary rules; verify the current coverage and state-specific implementation on the NHA portal.
documents_required: Documents requested by the empanelled facility
application_mode: Beneficiary verification and card services through official PM-JAY/NHA channels, empanelled hospitals, and State/UT systems
application_window: Beneficiary services are subject to current NHA and State/UT processes.
notes_flags: The NHA portal warns that pmjay.gov.in is the only official PM-JAY website; do not publish an income-only rule or a fixed benefit figure without the current scheme documentation.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
ministry_department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
eligibility_official: Fisheries-sector beneficiaries and eligible entities under the applicable PMMSY component, State/UT plan, and current operational guidelines.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are a fisher, fish farmer, fisheries worker, entrepreneur, or eligible fisheries entity under an active State/UT component.
benefits: Support for sustainable and responsible fisheries-sector development under the applicable component and approved plan.
application_mode: Through the Department of Fisheries and the prescribed State/UT fisheries implementation channel
application_window: Component and State/UT implementation windows apply.
notes_flags: The official page states an FY 2020-21 to FY 2024-25 implementation period; confirm current continuation and active application window before publishing.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan Yojana
ministry_department: Ministry of Labour and Employment
family_income_ceiling: Monthly income below ₹15,000
eligibility_official: Indian unorganised workers aged 18–40 who are not members of EPFO, ESIC, or a government-funded NPS and meet the current enrolment conditions.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an unorganised worker aged 18–40, earn below the current income limit, and are not covered by the excluded pension or social-security systems.
benefits: Voluntary contributory pension with a government matching contribution; the official summary states an assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60 and a spouse benefit under scheme rules.
application_mode: Online through the official Maandhan portal or prescribed assisted channel
application_window: Open subject to the current Maandhan enrolment process.
notes_flags: Confirm current contribution chart and exit/claim rules on the official Maandhan portal.

name: National Pension Scheme for Traders and the Self-employed Persons
ministry_department: Ministry of Labour and Employment
family_income_ceiling: Annual turnover not more than ₹1.5 crore
eligibility_official: Indian shopkeepers or owners of eligible petty or small shops, restaurants, hotels, or similar businesses aged 18–40, not covered by EPFO, ESIC, or PM-SYM, and within the current turnover condition.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an eligible small trader or self-employed person aged 18–40 and meet the turnover and social-security conditions.
benefits: Voluntary contributory pension with central-government matching; the official summary states an assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60.
application_mode: Online through the official Maandhan channel or prescribed assisted channel
application_window: Open subject to the current Maandhan enrolment process.
notes_flags: Confirm current contribution chart and business-category rules on the official portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
ministry_department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
eligibility_official: Indian citizens aged 18–70 with a Jan-Dhan or savings bank account linked as required, and consent for auto-debit under the scheme.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are 18–70 and hold an eligible bank account that can be enrolled through consent-based auto-debit.
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or full disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability under the current summary terms.
application_mode: Through a participating bank or official Jan Suraksha channel
application_window: Annual enrollment/renewal cycle as communicated by the participating bank.
notes_flags: Confirm the current premium, coverage exclusions, and renewal date from the latest official rules.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
ministry_department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
eligibility_official: Indian citizens aged 18–40 with an eligible bank account linked as required under the current APY rules.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are 18–40, are an Indian citizen, and can contribute through an eligible bank account.
benefits: Choice of a pension level from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 under the current scheme structure, with spouse and nominee provisions under the rules.
application_mode: Through a participating bank or official APY channel
application_window: Open subject to bank enrollment and current APY rules.
notes_flags: Confirm current contribution schedule and tax/eligibility rules before presenting a personalized recommendation.

name: Public Distribution System under NFSA and ONORC
ministry_department: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
family_income_ceiling: State/UT NFSA eligibility rules apply
eligibility_official: Eligible households identified under the applicable National Food Security Act and State/UT ration-card rules; ONORC supports portability for eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if your household is covered by the applicable NFSA and State/UT food-security entitlement.
benefits: Subsidized or entitled food grains under the applicable ration-card category and portability through One Nation One Ration Card where enabled.
documents_required: Aadhaar where required by the State/UT process
application_mode: Through the State/UT food and civil-supplies department or official NFSA channel
application_window: State/UT application and verification timelines apply.
notes_flags: Entitlement quantity and eligibility are State/UT and category dependent; never display a single nationwide quantity as universal.

name: National Social Assistance Programme - Old Age Support
ministry_department: Ministry of Rural Development
family_income_ceiling: State/UT and NSAP poverty/eligibility criteria apply
eligibility_official: Eligible Indian senior citizens with little or no regular means of subsistence under the applicable NSAP and State/UT rules.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an eligible older person without sufficient regular means of support and meet the current State/UT verification rules.
benefits: Central assistance combined with applicable State contribution; amount and age bands vary under current NSAP and State/UT rules.
application_mode: Through the official State/UT social-welfare or NSAP channel
application_window: State/UT application and verification timelines apply.
notes_flags: Pension amount and eligibility age/category must be displayed from the current State/UT and NSAP rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
ministry_department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility_official: Small and marginal farmers aged 18–40 with cultivable land up to 2 hectares as recorded by the relevant State/UT land records, subject to current exclusions.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are a small or marginal farmer aged 18–40 with eligible landholding and meet the current pension-scheme conditions.
benefits: Voluntary contributory pension with government matching contribution and an assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60 under the current summary.
application_mode: Through the official PM-KMY portal or prescribed assisted channel
application_window: Open subject to current PM-KMY enrollment and State/UT land-record verification.
notes_flags: Confirm current exclusions, contribution schedule, and application availability on PM-KMY before publication.

name: Self-Employment Scheme for Rehabilitation of Manual Scavengers
ministry_department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility_official: Identified manual scavengers, one from each eligible family, under the applicable rehabilitation and identification rules.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an officially identified manual scavenger or eligible dependent under the current rehabilitation process.
benefits: One-time cash assistance subject to current rules, free skill training, and a stated monthly training stipend, with amounts subject to revision by the implementing authority.
application_mode: Through the official NSKFDC or State implementing channel
application_window: Subject to identification and current State/NSKFDC implementation process.
notes_flags: Cash-assistance and stipend amounts require confirmation from the latest NSKFDC operational documents before publication.

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry_department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
eligibility_official: An artisan or craftsperson aged at least 18, working with hands and tools in one of the 18 listed family-based traditional trades on a self-employment basis; one member per family; government employees and their family members are excluded; prior similar credit restrictions apply.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are at least 18 and earn through one of the listed traditional trades, while meeting the family, government-service, and prior-loan conditions.
benefits: Recognition certificate and ID card, skill training, ₹500 per day training stipend, toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000, collateral-free credit support, digital-transaction incentive, and marketing support.
documents_required: Ration card or Aadhaar details of all family members where a ration card is unavailable
application_mode: Online through the official PM Vishwakarma portal, generally with CSC assistance
application_window: Open subject to portal and current scheme availability.
notes_flags: The official FAQ lists 18 trades and current loan/training terms; confirm current component availability before recommending credit.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
ministry_department: Ministry of Rural Development, National Social Assistance Programme
family_income_ceiling: Below Poverty Line under applicable norms
eligibility_official: Indian residents aged 18 or above with a qualifying severe disability under the current disability-certification and BPL rules; the captured page states 80% or more disability.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an eligible adult with a qualifying disability and belong to a BPL household under the current NSAP rules.
benefits: The captured official record states ₹300 per month for beneficiaries aged 18–79 and ₹500 per month for beneficiaries aged 80 and above, subject to current central and State/UT contributions.
documents_required: BPL card or applicable poverty-status proof
Disability certificate from the competent medical authority
application_mode: Online through UMANG or the official NSAP portal, and through prescribed State/UT/local-body channels
application_window: State/UT application and verification timelines apply.
notes_flags: Use the current NSAP guideline PDF linked on the official detail page for final disability threshold, pension amount, and State/UT rules.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
ministry_department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
eligibility_official: Street vendors holding a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card; identified vendors without those documents; or vendors with an official Letter of Recommendation from the ULB/Town Vending Committee, including eligible peri-urban or rural vendors operating within ULB limits.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are a street vendor with a vending identity document or an official ULB/TVC recommendation.
benefits: Working-capital loans in successive tranches up to ₹15,000, ₹25,000, and ₹50,000, 7% interest subsidy under current terms, digital-transaction cashback, credit-guarantee support, and a possible UPI-linked RuPay credit card after qualifying repayment.
documents_required: Certificate of Vending or Identity Card
ULB/TVC Letter of Recommendation where applicable
Voter ID, driving licence, MGNREGA card, or PAN for KYC
Loan-closure document for a later tranche where applicable
application_mode: Online through the official PM SVANidhi portal or through the prescribed ULB/assisted channel
application_window: Subject to current PM SVANidhi portal and lender availability.
notes_flags: The official detail page states current tranche, interest-subsidy, cashback, and credit-card terms; show the lender/portal confirmation before application.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
ministry_department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
eligibility_official: Individuals above 18 years may apply for eligible new micro-enterprises; for projects above the stated thresholds, at least VIII-standard qualification is required. Existing units and units already receiving government subsidy are excluded under the published rules.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are an adult setting up an eligible new micro-enterprise and meet the project, contribution, category, and activity rules.
benefits: Credit-linked margin-money subsidy for eligible new micro-enterprises, with different own-contribution and subsidy rates for general and special categories and higher support in rural areas under the published guidelines.
documents_required: Caste or special-category certificate where applicable
application_mode: Online through the official KVIC PMEGP e-portal and participating implementing agencies/banks
application_window: Current-cycle availability and annual allocations must be confirmed on the official KVIC portal.
notes_flags: The official page states continuation through 2025-26; verify current cycle, project ceilings, subsidy, and eligible activities before publication.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree)
ministry_department: All India Council for Technical Education
education_level: First-year degree or second-year degree through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution
family_income_ceiling: Not more than ₹8,00,000 per annum
eligibility_official: A girl student admitted to the first year of a degree course or second year through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution; maximum two girl children per family; family income not above ₹8 lakh per annum with a valid income certificate.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you are a girl student entering an eligible AICTE-approved degree course and your family income is within the current limit.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study, up to four years for first-year entrants or three years for lateral entrants, paid through DBT.
documents_required: Income certificate issued by the State/UT
application_mode: Online through the National Scholarship Portal after the AICTE application notice
application_window: Check the active NSP/AICTE cycle before applying.
notes_flags: The guideline PDF is dated 2020-21; verify current AICTE cycle and amount before publication.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (Diploma)
ministry_department: All India Council for Technical Education
education_level: First-year diploma or second-year diploma through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution
family_income_ceiling: Not more than ₹8,00,000 per annum
eligibility_official: A student with at least 40% disability admitted to the first year of a diploma course or second year through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution; current family-income certification is required.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you have at least 40% disability, are entering an eligible AICTE-approved diploma course, and meet the income limit.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study, up to three years for first-year entrants or two years for lateral entrants, paid through DBT.
documents_required: Income certificate issued by the State/UT
application_mode: Online through the National Scholarship Portal after the AICTE application notice
application_window: Check the active NSP/AICTE cycle before applying.
notes_flags: The guideline PDF is dated 2020-21; verify current AICTE cycle and amount before publication.

name: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
ministry_department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
education_level: Full-time prescribed course beyond Class XII in a notified top-class institution
family_income_ceiling: Total annual family income up to ₹2,50,000
eligibility_official: OBC, EBC, or DNT students with annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh who secure admission to a full-time prescribed course in a notified institution, subject to available slots, merit, sibling limits, and current rules.
eligibility_plain: You may qualify if you belong to OBC, EBC, or DNT categories, meet the income limit, and have admission to a notified top-class institution.
benefits: Full tuition and non-refundable charges within the scheme ceilings, ₹3,000 per month living expenses, ₹5,000 per year for books and stationery, and one-time computer/laptop assistance up to ₹45,000 under the guideline.
application_mode: Online through the National Scholarship Portal with institution verification
application_window: Check the current NSP cycle and notified-institution list before applying.
notes_flags: Slots and notified institutions can change by financial year; display the current list and current NSP dates.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme
ministry_department: National Savings Institute, Ministry of Finance
eligibility_official: An account may be opened in the name of a girl child until she attains 10 years of age; one account is permitted per girl child under the scheme rules.
eligibility_plain: A parent or guardian can open this government savings account for an eligible girl child before her tenth birthday.
benefits: Government small-savings account with deposits from ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year, education-withdrawal provisions, transferability across India, 21-year maturity, and tax treatment under applicable law.
application_mode: Open through a post office or authorised bank using the official form and KYC process
application_window: Account opening is subject to the scheme rules and authorised-bank/post-office service availability.
notes_flags: This is a savings account scheme, not an automatic cash-benefit grant; interest rates and tax rules should be checked against current official notifications.

name: PM CARES for Children Scheme
ministry_department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
education_level: School and higher education support for eligible beneficiaries
eligibility_official: Children who lost both parents, a surviving parent, or legal/adoptive parents to the COVID-19 pandemic between 11 March 2020 and 5 May 2023, and who had not completed 18 years on the date of the parents' death, subject to official beneficiary identification.
eligibility_plain: This is for children officially identified as having lost eligible parents or guardians to COVID-19 while they were under 18.
benefits: The official FAQ lists health insurance, school and higher-education support, ₹20,000 annual school scholarship, ₹4,000 monthly Mission Vatsalya support where applicable, education-loan interest subsidy, and a corpus designed to reach ₹10 lakh with payment at age 23 under the scheme rules.
documents_required: Proof of death and COVID-period eligibility
PM CARES beneficiary certificate/ID where issued
Bank and education records where applicable
application_mode: Through the official PM CARES for Children portal, caregiver/agency, or Child Welfare Committee channel for beneficiary identification
application_window: Enrollment eligibility is tied to the published COVID-period criteria and official beneficiary identification.
notes_flags: Display only for officially identified beneficiaries; do not present it as an open general application scheme.

name: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services and Child Welfare Services)
ministry_department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
family_income_ceiling: Caregiver family income below ₹8,00,000 per annum or current Ministry rule
eligibility_official: Children below 18 may qualify for sponsorship, foster care, or adoption-related services; after-care can support young people leaving Child Care Institutions from age 18 up to 21, extendable to 23, subject to State/UT and district procedures.
eligibility_plain: Children needing care or protection and eligible foster, caregiver, or after-care applicants may receive support through the State and district child-protection system.
benefits: Family-based sponsorship and foster-care support, adoption facilitation, after-care assistance, and a ₹4,000 monthly grant to States under sponsorship, foster care, or after-care components, subject to applicable approval.
documents_required: Child Welfare Committee, foster, adoption, or special-needs records where applicable
application_mode: Through State/UT Women and Child Development departments, District Child Protection Units, Child Welfare Committees, or prescribed child-protection channels
